$comment: Observed UV4.exe command-line behaviour, verified on 2026-10-28 against UV4.exe sha256 428baf13d15e6760af1618def9c9815c97f0321cc5e459ec7adc4dde41c42f89 (MDK 5.43a, MDK-Lite non-commercial). Evidence: runtime matrix in reverse/cli_matrix.json + help pages uv4_commandline.html.

-b.desc: Build current target (or batch-selected targets) and exit

-c.desc: Clean all project targets and exit

-cr.desc: Clean all targets then re-translate current target

-z.desc: Re-build ALL targets (multi-project); hangs when a single-target project is passed

-q.desc: Re-build selected targets of a multi-project (.uvmpw/.uvmpwx); hangs when a single-target project is passed

-d.desc: Start debugging mode (use with debug init script + EXIT command)

-f.desc: Download program to Flash and exit

-5.desc: Convert uVision4 .uvproj to uVision5 .uvprojx; -l logfile; error 20 on failure

-X.desc: Generate preprocessor symbol file co-arm_<target>.h/hpp in target output folder

-X1.desc: Generate preprocessor symbol files for all targets

options.-j0: Hide GUI, suppress message boxes (batch mode)
options.-i <xml>: Create/update project from XML (project_import.xsd); GUI suppressed
options.-n <device>: Create new project for device; GUI suppressed
options.-np <device>: Create project if absent, otherwise update device in all targets; GUI suppressed
options.-s <port>: Enable UVSOCK TCP/IP remote-control server on port
options.-x: DDE mode, complete command output (only with -d)

errorlevel.11: Cannot open project file for writing
errorlevel.12: Device name not found in database

observed_behaviour.size_line: Program Size: Code=<n> RO-data=<n> RW-data=<n> ZI-data=<n>
observed_behaviour.last_command_state: UV4 rewrites <project>.uvoptx (last target, debug opts) after any command; a lost lock or 'is already opened' message means another instance owns the project.

-c: deletes intermediate output files for each target
-f: flash programming over configured debug adapter
-s: UVSOCK TCP listener: handshake/sync port pair, service id UVSOCK

license.vendor_daemon: UV4\armlm.exe (Arm License Manager), helper armlm-ipc.exe, rpc dll armlm.dll
license.first_stream: armlm-ipc.exe streams bundled license data (7.4 MB) to armlm.exe; armlm-ipc is the bootstrap/inter-process transport for the local license server
license.observable: UV4.exe imports ARMLM.DLL (DLL name strings present, library absent from PATH at load time unless launched in UV4 dir); toolchain version gates appear as Error #601 'no MDK-ARM license is available' before build.
license.env: No disassembly performed of the license manager binaries in this pass; treat armlm* as black-box and only expose status queries.
